title: Discovery of novel STAT3 DNA binding domain inhibitors.
authors: Wu, Bocheng; Payero, Benny; Taylor, Sydney; Oyelere, Adegboyega K
one_liner_zh: 该文基于结构设计STAT3 DNA结合域抑制剂，涉及TF-DNA互作靶点但以药物发现为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属广义蛋白-DNA互作相关但深度不足。
abstract: Background: STAT3 is a pro-oncogenic transcription factor. Pyrimethamine (PYM) is a STAT3 inhibitor that suppresses the proliferation of some cancer cells through downregulation of STAT3 target proteins. Methodology & Results: We have used structure-based tools to design novel PYM-based compounds. Intracellular target validation studies revealed that representative compounds 11b-d and 15a downregulate STAT3 downstream proteins and inhibit STAT3 DNA binding domain (DBD). Relative to PYM, a cohort of these compounds are >100-fold more cytotoxic to cancer cells with constitutively active (high pSTAT3) and basal (low pSTAT3) STAT3 signaling, suggesting that STAT3 DBD inhibition is deleterious to the proliferation of cancer cells with low and high pSTAT3 levels. Conclusion: These are promising leads for further preclinical evaluation as therapeutic agents for STAT3-dependent cancers.
abstract_zh: 背景：STAT3是一种促癌转录因子。乙胺嘧啶（PYM）是一种STAT3抑制剂，通过下调STAT3靶蛋白来抑制某些癌细胞的增殖。方法与结果：我们利用基于结构的工具设计了新型PYM类化合物。细胞内靶点验证研究表明，代表性化合物11b-d和15a可下调STAT3下游蛋白，并抑制STAT3 DNA结合域（DBD）。与PYM相比，这些化合物中的一组对具有组成性激活（高pSTAT3）和基础（低pSTAT3）STAT3信号传导的癌细胞的细胞毒性高出>100倍，表明STAT3 DBD抑制对低和高pSTAT3水平癌细胞的增殖均具有不利影响。结论：这些化合物作为STAT3依赖性癌症治疗剂的临床前评估具有前景的先导候选物。
